newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Four die in Colombian rebel attack.
newsitem.headline: Four die in Colombian rebel attack.

text.p: Three agents of the state security service DAS and a cattle farmer were killed when leftist rebels attacked a ranch in northern Colombia, officials said on Wednesday.

The agents were investigating cases of cattle rustling near the town of Since, in Sucre province, on Tuesday when they came under fire from Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) fighters, police said.
The firefight came against the backdrop of 2 1/2 months of intense guerrilla activity, which military experts described as one of the bloodiest guerrilla offensives in decades.

Army commander-in-chief Brig. Gen. Manuel Jose Bonett, appointed after a defence reshuffle two weeks ago, told Reuters this week he was looking to double the size of his combat force in the course of next year.

The army has about 100,000 troops, one-third of whom are tied up protecting key structures such as oil pipelines, favourite targets of rebel attacks. Bonett, accused of human rights violations by Colombian rights groups, estimated the number of leftist guerrillas at no more than 10,000 and said his aim was to force them to the negotiating table not annihilate them.
